triples.head_surface: Flexible hoses constructed of rubber or plastics materials and intended for use in bilge, ballast, compressed air, oil fuel, lubricating, hydraulic and thermal oil systems
triples.head_canonical_zh: 用于舱底、压载、压缩空气、燃油、润滑油、液压油及热油系统的橡胶或塑料软管
triples.tail_surface: incorporate a single or double closely woven integral wire braid or other suitable material reinforcement
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 包含单层或双层紧密编织的整体钢丝编织层或其他合适的材料增强层
triples.evidence_text: Flexible hoses constructed of rubber or plastics materials and intended for use in bilge, ballast, compressed air, oil fuel, lubricating, hydraulic and thermal oil systems are to incorporate a single or double closely woven integral wire braid or other suitable material reinforcement.

triples.head_surface: rubber or plastics materials hoses ... used in oil supply lines to burners
triples.head_canonical_zh: 用于燃烧器供油管路的橡胶或塑料软管
triples.tail_surface: have external wire braid protection in addition to the integral reinforcement
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 除整体增强层外还需具备外部钢丝编织保护层
triples.evidence_text: Where rubber or plastics materials hoses are to be used in oil supply lines to burners, the hoses are to have external wire braid protection in addition to the integral reinforcement.

triples.head_surface: Flexible hoses for use in steam systems
triples.evidence_text: Flexible hoses for use in steam systems are to be of metallic construction.

triples.head_surface: hose clamps and similar types of end attachments
triples.head_canonical_zh: 软管卡箍及类似端部附件
triples.tail_surface: The use of hose clamps and similar types of end attachments is not acceptable for flexible hoses in piping systems for steam, flammable media, starting air or for sea water where failure may result in flooding
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 禁止在蒸汽、易燃介质、启动空气或失效可能导致进水的海水管路系统的软管上使用卡箍
triples.evidence_text: The use of hose clamps and similar types of end attachments is not acceptable for flexible hoses in piping systems for steam, flammable media, starting air or for sea water where failure may result in flooding.

triples.tail_surface: The use of hose clamps and similar types of end attachments is not acceptable for flexible hoses in piping systems for steam, flammable media, starting air or for sea water where failure may result in flooding
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 禁止在关键系统软管上使用卡箍以防止失效进水
triples.evidence_text: The use of hose clamps and similar types of end attachments is not acceptable for flexible hoses in piping systems for steam, flammable media, starting air or for sea water where failure may result in flooding.

triples.head_surface: Flexible hose assemblies constructed of non-metallic materials intended for installation in piping systems for flammable media and sea water systems where failure may result in flooding
triples.head_canonical_zh: 用于易燃介质及可能因失效导致进水的海水系统的非金属软管组件
triples.evidence_text: Flexible hose assemblies constructed of non-metallic materials intended for installation in piping systems for flammable media and sea water systems where failure may result in flooding, are to be of a fire-resistant type*
Fire resistance is to be demonstrated by testing to ISO 15540 and ISO 15541.

triples.head_surface: installation of a shutoff valve immediately upstream of a sea water hose
triples.head_canonical_zh: 在海水软管上游紧邻处安装截止阀
triples.tail_surface: does not satisfy the requirement for fire-resistant type hose
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 不满足耐火型软管的要求（即不能替代耐火软管）
triples.evidence_text: The installation of a shutoff valve immediately upstream of a sea water hose does not satisfy the requirement for fire-resistant type hose.

triples.head_surface: Flexible hose assemblies intended for installation in piping systems where pressure pulses and/or high levels of vibration are expected to occur in service
triples.head_canonical_zh: 用于预期存在压力脉冲和/或高振动的管路系统的软管组件
triples.tail_surface: pressure pulses and/or high levels of vibration
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 压力脉冲和/或高水平振动
triples.evidence_text: Flexible hose assemblies intended for installation in piping systems where pressure pulses and/or high levels of vibration are expected to occur in service

triples.tail_surface: are not to be installed where they may be subjected to torsion deformation (twisting) under normal operating conditions
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 不得安装在正常工况下可能承受扭转变形的部位
triples.evidence_text: Flexible hose assemblies are not to be installed where they may be subjected to torsion deformation (twisting) under normal operating conditions.

triples.tail_surface: are not to be installed where they may be subjected to torsion deformation (twisting) under normal operating conditions
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 避免安装在可能发生扭转的位置
triples.evidence_text: Flexible hose assemblies are not to be installed where they may be subjected to torsion deformation (twisting) under normal operating conditions.

triples.head_surface: risk of ignition due to failure of the hose assembly
triples.head_canonical_zh: 因软管组件失效引起的着火风险
triples.tail_surface: piping systems conveying flammable fluids that are in close proximity of heated surfaces
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 靠近加热表面的输送易燃流体的管路系统
triples.evidence_text: Where flexible hoses are intended to be used in piping systems conveying flammable fluids that are in close proximity of heated surfaces the risk of ignition due to failure of the hose assembly
